mistake.headline:
Too heavy.

mistake.body: The most common curl mistake I see. If you're swinging like this, you're not really working your biceps.

fix.headline:
Strict.
Bicep only.
fix.body: Stand straight up and down. Curl with the bicep only, then go right back. [em]No swinging, no rocking, no momentum.[/em]
